items.title: 3 Value Dividend Stocks To Watch As Rate Cut Hopes Fade
items.summary: The Federal Reserve has a tougher call coming as a hot jobs market, sticky 3.7% inflation and a key CPI report on 10 November all pull rate expectations higher, and that tension is where opportunity often hides. While growth stocks can feel the heat when yields climb, some large value and dividend payers can look relatively steadier. This article walks through 3 stocks from our screener that appear more directly exposed to this rate story and explains why they might deserve a spot on your...

items.title: 3M Cut Its Dividend After 64 Years of Raises. Is It Finally a Buy Again?
items.summary: 3M broke a 64-year streak, shed its forever-chemicals baggage, and just settled its biggest legal fight. Retirees now face a harder question: do the payout math, the cash drains, and two rival dividend payers justify trusting the company with income again?

items.title: Honeywell Split Up. Here’s Why Longtime Investors Are Getting Smaller Dividend Checks
items.summary: One of industrials' steadiest dividend payers just broke into two stocks, and the math on your quarterly check may surprise you. One half carries heavy debt and legal baggage, while the other has a CEO who never mentioned the payout.
